concept: A contact form as a chrome counter bell on a lagoon-blue counter, rendered in 3D (Blender) and shot from the same side four ways. The button goes down twice: they pressed Send. Right up against the button: did it go? Then what should come back, a till slip resting against the bell: RECEIVED, your message, ref 2318. Then right along the slip to the line that matters, WE'LL REPLY BY 10AM MON: say when. Lagoon blue, polished chrome, black enamel, till-roll white and deep ink type.
